name: FigCraft Script-First
description: Plan a FigCraft screen as a JSON command script, run it headlessly in one undoable batch, then verify
author: Reff33
related_note: Complements the bundled FigCraft app skill. That one documents what FigCraft can do; this one is the execution loop.
ai_instructions:
Drive FigCraft by writing one JSON command script and running it in a single batch — never by clicking through the GUI.

1. Plan in text first: list frames, then each child layer with type and coordinates.
2. Write a spec (not commands) and expand it:
   node rigtools/figcraft_script/build.mjs spec.json --out figcraft-script.json
3. Confirm the CLI exists: figcraft-cli --version (or figcraft-cli.exe on Windows).
4. Run: figcraft-cli run figcraft-script.json --out screen.figcraft
5. Verify: figcraft-cli info screen.figcraft --json, then export a PNG at --scale 2 and look at it.

If figcraft-cli is missing, INSTALL IT — do not stop and ask. On Windows the CLI is inside the portable zip next to figcraft.exe (figcraft-cli.exe, verified in release v0.18.1):
  download https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/releases/download/v<ver>/figcraft-<ver>-windows-x64-portable.zip
  verify SHA256SUMS.txt from the same release, Expand-Archive into %LOCALAPPDATA%FigCraft, then run the figcraft-cli.exe found inside the unpacked folder.
macOS: figcraft-cli-<ver>-macos-universal.zip from the release. Linux: FigCraft.AppImage cli <args>.
Only if the user declines the install: emit the .figcraft scaffold and say plainly it was not run. Never claim a screen works without info + PNG verification.
Full guide: rigtools/figcraft_script/SKILL.md. App capabilities: rigtools/artcraft/figcraft/SKILL.md.

claude_command.name: figcraft-script
claude_command.content:
# /figcraft-script

Build a FigCraft screen fast: spec -> command script -> headless run -> verify (info + PNG). If figcraft-cli is missing, install it from the release portable zip. Full guide at rigtools/figcraft_script/SKILL.md.
